integrity: Analytic proof with an independent standalone symbolic/numerical checker; numerical quadratures are finite corroboration, not proofs of limiting statements. No independent mathematical validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The explicit cusp scaling and occupation conclusion hold for the stated contracting cubic family with fixed tau>-2 sqrt(omega); there is no periodic orbit at the depinning boundary. The convergence of the planar occupation measure is weak, not total variation. The exponent three quarters and the general physical-time period identity are established background. Priority outside inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: A quartic depinning cusp and a resolved physical-time occupation law for a contracting cubic star-node flow
